analysis: Price has expanded above VAH (75,350) driven primarily by aggressive perpetual leverage delta rather than organic spot accumulation. With perp volume outpacing spot volume by more than five-to-one, the move risks long exhaustion if spot buyers fail to absorb sell liquidity at new highs.
